data_flowchart.description: Engine processing pipeline — Base44 compatible. Safe for public/clinical-facing spec.
steps: 2. Axis Probability Model (0–100% per axis, 7 axes)
3. Transition Detection Engine (primary + optional secondary transition, with clinical explanation)
4. Expression Pattern Classifier (Neurovascular / Mechanical-Fascial / Autonomic-Sensory Amplification)
5. Treatment Cluster Selector (1 primary + 1 secondary cluster)
6. Clinical Summary (1–2 sentences for residents and specialists)

notes: Decision priority hierarchy is mandatory: DO_NOT rules > DO rules > intervention choice.
Trauma roles (victim/savior/perpetrator), germ layers, and meridian axes are INDEPENDENT but LINKED enums. Do not collapse into single classification.
Pain syndromes are SECONDARY attributes — never use as primary classification keys in engine logic.
State switching over time must be supported — no static role/axis assignment.
TCM formula logic (Liu Wei Di Huang Wan, Huang Lian Jie Du Tang) is BACKEND ONLY. Never surface to front-end output.
Transition Engine v1.0 is designed for Base44 backend. Clinical-facing spec is NYSORA-compatible and evidence-aligned.
The 7-axis model and 7-cluster selector are the core routing mechanism of the engine. Each axis/cluster pair must be implemented as a linked but independent enum.
Backend physical model (fascia as tensegrity antenna, mitochondria as field stabilisers) does not appear in any front-end output but drives all probability calculations.
